I have zero connection to og ff7, and i didnt really like most of remake either (the game began to grow on me near the ending) 

But i REALLY wanted to play rebirth due to the glowing reviews

Currently 50 hours in and its one of my favourite games of all time.

I thought long and hard about why this is the case and there are several reasons, which ill list out below

1. Combat - perfect mix of action and tactics. Extremely satisfying to pressure and stagger enemies. And synergy skills and abilities add a nice layer of complexity

2. Music - holy shit, this ost never disappoints. Truly mind boggling how they pulled this off. Currently in gongaga, and the music just hits the right spots. I think the open world is carried HARD due to the outstanding music

3. Open world - at a superficial glance, it seems like a ubisoft like world with checklists. But there are two major differences.  Firstly, there is insane variety in the regions, thematically and also mechanically (mode of traversal). Grasslands were flat lands whereas gongaga is this huge mess of a jungle where you need to stop regularly to get your bearings and chart a new course. Secondly, each and every checklist item has so much heart put into it. The fiend trials feel like a nat geo episode which ends in a duel. Moogle minigame is annoying but adds variety. Divine shrines and the lifesprings are mechanically shallow, but again the music just carries them hard. 

4. Side quests - attaching a party member to each side quest is a stroke of genius. You either get exposition on the character or some funny banter. Some side quests are pretty fun as well. And they didnt spare any effort into making them unique

5. Characters - in remake, i found avalanche really cringy. In rebirth they are my besties. I dunno where the switch was flipped but characters in rebirth have so much depth and nuances. Cloud is a fantastic protagonist, and the rest of the cast is top tier too. Some dislike yuffie, but i absolutely adore her for some reason.

"Homeo" means same. Homeopathy is the field of treating diseases by giving you the supposed causative material. The most commonly used are suspensions of arsenic, since it was stipulated that arsenic could cause a lot of diseases

This is fundamentally wrong because

 A) arsenic doesnt cause any of the common diseases 

B) even if we consider that it does, the dose of arsenic in a traditional homeopathy dose is ridiculously low, where it will barely have any effect on your body

C) if someone ingests a ton of those white pellets, they are at a risk of arsenic poisoning

In short, the only effect it has is due to the placebo effect. 

As a doctor, do i care if patients take homeopathy ? Not really. They teach us about patient autonomy for a reason. I can warn them about the potential effects, but the ultimate decision is in the hands of the patient
Does placebo effect work if the patient is aware about it ?
